svg.aria-label: Walkthrough of Chawakom-2 Digital Evidence & Forensic Architecture, in five steps
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Raw chat screenshots and bank slips are sorted into specialized pipelines.
Dual OCR and invisible Tahoma vectorization
Thai diacritics are parsed and layered behind high-res images with zero text collision.
Civil loan claims and criminal fraud elements are systematically identified.
Jinnipha received ฿217k directly while ฿36k went to 9 third-party creditors.
Court-grade PDF, 90 story cards, and offline AI search are compiled for litigation.
